caption: The drawing depicts a robed figure standing at the center, dressed in a long, flowing robe shaded in light and medium pink, with red vertical stripes and small red circles running down the front. The figure wears a wide-brimmed hat matching the pinks of the robe. The figure has a long, straight beard and holds a cross with one hand at chest level, while the other hand holds a rectangular book, depicted with a golden outline. The halo behind the figure's head is shaded with yellow, and the background features a soft blue gradient set within an arched frame. Around the arch are vines with green leaves and purple grape clusters drawn above the figure’s head. Six gold and blue five-pointed stars are dispersed around the figure within the arched frame, and the figure stands on a green patch of land bordered by stylized blue waves at the bottom.
title: San Buenaventura
